_readme: Edit this file to change the margin model. run_nightly.py reads it every run.
monthly_fixed_costs are AMORTIZED to a daily rate (month total / days in that month)
and subtracted below CM3 to produce Net. They never touch CM1/CM2/CM3.
using the mean of Apr/May/Jun 2026 (the last three complete months).

Velantra._shipping_note: UNSET. Triple Whale reports 0 shipping cost and Shopify carries 0g weights store-wide, so per-order shipping cannot be derived. Set a flat per-order estimate from the Ecomflow rate card. While null, CM2 excludes shipping and the dashboard flags it.

Motilli._note: Not connected to this Triple Whale account (Access Denied). Enable once TW access exists, or it runs Shopify-only with no ad spend.

monthly_fixed_costs._comment: Shared across all brands unless 'brand' is set on the line. Allocated per the allocation block below.

lines.name: Payroll / salaries
lines._note: P&L shows $0 payroll Jan-Jul 2026. Set this when you start running salaries.

allocation._methods: revenue_share = split shared fixed costs across enabled brands by their share of net revenue that day. fixed = use explicit_share below.

cogs._source_options: shopify = per-order unit cost scraped from Shopify (authoritative). triplewhale = TW cost_of_goods.
cogs._fallback_note: If a line item has no unit cost on its variant, COGS for that line is counted as 0 and the unit is recorded in cogs_coverage so the dashboard can show how much revenue is uncosted. Set a 0-1 fraction to impute instead.

chargebacks._note: Pulled from Shopify Payments disputes. Lost disputes are booked as a CM2 cost on the day they are lost. Material historically: $12.5K in Jan 2026.

payment_fees._note: TW payment_gateway_costs had 99.7% coverage on Velantra. Falls back to rate_pct + flat per order if TW is unavailable.
